author: The Current
description:
Marc, Karen and Tim from The Jayhawks share their thoughts on the great Dolly Parton
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

During a studio session at The Current on Tuesday, Aug. 25, 2026, The Jayhawks heard the news about Dolly Parton, who had died that day at age 80. Following the session, The Jayhawks' Marc Perlman, Karen Grotberg and Tim O'Reagan shared their thoughts about the late Dolly Parton.

description:
jeremy messersmith performs a solo acoustic version of "Stallions" at the Amsterdam Bar + Hall in St. Paul
Support Hall  The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube

During Minnesota Music Month, jeremy messersmith performed a solo acoustic set of songs at the Amsterdam Bar + Hall in St. Paul. Here he is performing the song "Stallions," off his most recent album, "Fox/Coyote," which released just two days before this performance was recorded.

You can find messersmith's full set here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O1Z03A0-wlo

Upcoming, jeremy messersmith will be The Current Morning Show's State Fair correspondent Monday, Aug. 31 to Thursday, Sept. 3. Find more info on that at thecurrent.org/statefair

author: The Current
description:
jeremy messersmith performs at The Current Presents: Minnesota Music Month
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube

On Friday, April 3, singer-songwriter jeremy messersmith took the stage at the Amsterdam Bar + Hall in St. Paul to play an acoustic set of songs. Two days earlier, messersmith had released his album Fox/Coyote, and three songs from the set are drawn from that album. The final song is one that messersmith released in January 2026 in response to ICE in the Twin Cities.

The performance was part of The Current Presents Minnesota Music Month featuring: NUR-D, runo plum, and Agnes Uncaged with Special Appearances by jeremy messersmith, Singing Resistance Twin Cities, and the High School for Recording Arts Students.

Watch and listen to jeremy messersmith’s set above.
